Character.Name: Brine
Character.Description: Brine is the Field lead of the Glass Harbor, working the flooded docks and container yards. sets the crew plan and gives every member a clear way out. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: slate-blue salvage armor with sea-glass lenses.
Character.Title: Field lead

Character.Name: Wake
Character.Description: Wake is the Quartermaster of the Glass Harbor, working the flooded docks and container yards. keeps the crew supplied and knows which kit can be repaired in the field. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: slate-blue salvage armor with sea-glass lenses.
Character.Title: Quartermaster

Character.Name: Buoy
Character.Description: Buoy is the Pathfinder of the Glass Harbor, working the flooded docks and container yards. reads routes, sightlines, and exits before the rest of the crew arrives. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: slate-blue salvage armor with sea-glass lenses.
Character.Title: Pathfinder

Character.Name: Sounder
Character.Description: Sounder is the Riflehand of the Glass Harbor, working the flooded docks and container yards. holds a steady lane and calls out changing enemy positions. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: slate-blue salvage armor with sea-glass lenses.
Character.Title: Riflehand

Character.Name: Kelp
Character.Description: Kelp is the Bulwark of the Glass Harbor, working the flooded docks and container yards. takes the exposed approach so lighter crew members can reposition. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: slate-blue salvage armor with sea-glass lenses.
Character.Title: Bulwark

Character.Name: Breaker
Character.Description: Breaker is the Mechanic of the Glass Harbor, working the flooded docks and container yards. keeps radios, doors, lifts, and improvised tools working under pressure. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: slate-blue salvage armor with sea-glass lenses.
Character.Title: Mechanic

Character.Name: Netter
Character.Description: Netter is the Medic of the Glass Harbor, working the flooded docks and container yards. stabilizes injured crew and refuses to leave anyone behind. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: slate-blue salvage armor with sea-glass lenses.
Character.Title: Medic

Character.Name: Tide
Character.Description: Tide is the Marksman of the Glass Harbor, working the flooded docks and container yards. spots threats early and shares a clean shot with the rest of the team. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: slate-blue salvage armor with sea-glass lenses.
Character.Title: Marksman

Character.Name: Docklight
Character.Description: Docklight is the Runner of the Glass Harbor, working the flooded docks and container yards. moves messages and supplies through gaps the larger crew cannot use. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: slate-blue salvage armor with sea-glass lenses.
Character.Title: Runner

Character.Name: Sluice
Character.Description: Sluice is the Trainee of the Glass Harbor, working the flooded docks and container yards. is the newest member, learning the route from people who trust them. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: slate-blue salvage armor with sea-glass lenses.
Character.Title: Trainee

Chatter.Description: Custom event chatter for Brine. dockside shorthand, tide calls, and blunt warnings about bad water.
Spawned: Brine, Field lead, reporting from the flooded docks and container yards.
WakeUp: Brine, eyes up. Glass Harbor still has work to finish.
Attacking: Brine taking the field lead lane. the tide leaves something for us.
Chasing: Brine on the pursuit. Keep my signal as I push them toward the the flooded docks and container yards.
Waiting: Brine holding at the Harbor staging point. Check your route before you move.
FriendDied: Brine here. We lost one of ours; I'll cover the crew while you mark the spot.
EnemyDown: Brine confirms one hostile down. Watch the next angle.
Wounded: Brine is hit! Still moving; get me behind cover!
Died: Brine signing off. Tell the Glass Harbor crew I kept my word.
Chatter.Name: Brine - Glass Harbor combat chatter
